subject: Add sentinel_total_tilt to sentinel INFO sentinel (#1904)
reason: The change is confined to Sentinel mode: sentinel.c adds an int total_tilt counter, increments it when sentinelCheckTiltCondition() enters TILT, and prints it as a new sentinel_total_tilt line in INFO sentinel. That code only runs in a valkey-sentinel process (started with --sentinel or the valkey-sentinel exec name). No installed experiment, component, or deployment mode can start a Sentinel: deployment modes are standalone and cluster only, the private servers of valkey.action.commands and valkey.action.tools are ordinary servers whose mode cannot be switched via server_config (sentinel mode
